title: Data Analyst Career Roadmap
summary: A practical pathway from solid fundamentals to a job‑ready portfolio, focusing on the essential tools and storytelling skills. Follow the phases to build confidence, create showcase projects, and land your first analyst role.

phases.title: Foundations
phases.summary: Build core quantitative and spreadsheet competence.

milestones.title: Master Spreadsheet Functions
milestones.outcome: You can clean, transform, and analyze data using advanced Excel/Google Sheets features.

tasks.title: Review key formulas
tasks.description: Study VLOOKUP, INDEX/MATCH, SUMIFS, and array formulas on Microsoft support pages.

tasks.title: Create a data cleaning sheet
tasks.description: Import a messy CSV and use text‑to‑columns, TRIM, and conditional formatting to tidy it.

tasks.title: Build a pivot table report
tasks.description: Summarize sales data by region and product, adding slicers for interactivity.

tasks.title: Reflect on errors
tasks.description: Note three common mistakes you made and how you fixed them.

milestones.title: Fundamentals of Statistics
milestones.outcome: You can describe data distributions, test hypotheses, and interpret confidence intervals.

tasks.title: Read descriptive stats chapter
tasks.description: Use Khan Academy’s statistics section to review mean, median, variance, and standard deviation.

tasks.title: Calculate summary stats in Sheets
tasks.description: Apply built‑in functions to a sample dataset and verify results manually.

tasks.title: Perform a t‑test in Sheets
tasks.description: Use the =TTEST function on two sample groups and interpret the p‑value.

tasks.title: Summarize findings
tasks.description: Write a one‑page interpretation of the test outcome for a non‑technical audience.

tasks.title: Join a stats forum
tasks.description: Introduce yourself on Cross‑Validated and ask a question about a concept you find tricky.

phases.title: Core Skills
phases.summary: Gain proficiency in SQL, Python, and visualisation tools.

milestones.title: SQL Querying Basics
milestones.outcome: You can extract, filter, and aggregate data from relational databases.

tasks.title: Complete SELECT tutorial
tasks.description: Follow the freeCodeCamp SQL basics lesson and run queries on the provided SQLite database.

tasks.title: Write a join query
tasks.description: Combine two tables (orders and customers) to list orders with customer names.

tasks.title: Create a summary view
tasks.description: Use GROUP BY and HAVING to produce monthly sales totals and filter low‑volume months.

tasks.title: Explain query plan
tasks.description: Describe in one paragraph how the database processes your join query.

tasks.title: Share query on forum
tasks.description: Post your query and results on Stack Overflow for feedback.

milestones.title: Python & pandas for Analysis
milestones.outcome: You can load, clean, and manipulate datasets programmatically.

tasks.title: Watch pandas intro video
tasks.description: Use the official pandas documentation tutorial videos to understand DataFrames.

tasks.title: Load a CSV with pandas
tasks.description: Write a script that reads a public dataset and prints the first five rows.

tasks.title: Clean missing values
tasks.description: Implement .fillna() and .dropna() strategies on the dataset and justify choices.

tasks.title: Group and aggregate data
tasks.description: Calculate average sales per category using .groupby() and .agg().

tasks.title: Document code
tasks.description: Add comments and a README explaining your data pipeline steps.

milestones.title: Data Visualisation Essentials
milestones.outcome: You can create clear charts and dashboards that highlight insights.

tasks.title: Read chart‑type guide
tasks.description: Study the Data Visualization section on MDN for best‑practice chart selections.

tasks.title: Build a bar chart in Sheets
tasks.description: Visualise monthly revenue using a stacked bar chart with labels.

tasks.title: Create a line plot with matplotlib
tasks.description: Plot time‑series data in Python, adding titles and axis labels.

tasks.title: Design a simple dashboard
tasks.description: Combine three charts in a Google Data Studio report linked to your spreadsheet.

tasks.title: Get feedback on visuals
tasks.description: Share your dashboard on a data‑analysis community and note two improvement suggestions.

phases.title: Proof of Work
phases.summary: Develop portfolio projects that demonstrate end‑to‑end analysis.

milestones.title: Sales Dashboard Project
milestones.outcome: You can turn raw sales data into an interactive dashboard with key KPIs.

tasks.title: Select public sales dataset
tasks.description: Download a CSV from Kaggle’s open datasets that includes date, product, and revenue fields.

tasks.title: Clean data in pandas
tasks.description: Handle missing dates, correct data types, and create a ‘month’ column.

tasks.title: Create visualisations
tasks.description: Produce a bar chart of revenue by product and a line chart of monthly trends using matplotlib or Sheets.

tasks.title: Assemble dashboard
tasks.description: Combine the charts in Google Data Studio, adding filters for region and product.

tasks.title: Write project summary
tasks.description: Draft a one‑page write‑up describing the problem, approach, and insights for a hiring manager.

milestones.title: A/B Test Analysis Write‑up
milestones.outcome: You can design, analyze, and communicate results of controlled experiments.

tasks.title: Find A/B test dataset
tasks.description: Use a public experiment dataset from Kaggle (e.g., website conversion data).

tasks.title: Formulate hypotheses
tasks.description: State null and alternative hypotheses for the key metric.

tasks.title: Run statistical test in Sheets
tasks.description: Apply a chi‑square or t‑test using built‑in functions and record the p‑value.

tasks.title: Visualise results
tasks.description: Create a side‑by‑side bar chart comparing control and variant performance.

tasks.title: Compose executive summary
tasks.description: Write a concise report (max 500 words) for stakeholders, focusing on impact and next steps.

milestones.title: Cohort Retention Report
milestones.outcome: You can track user cohorts over time and present retention insights.

tasks.title: Obtain user activity data
tasks.description: Download a sample user‑event CSV from a public data repository.

tasks.title: Define cohorts in pandas
tasks.description: Group users by signup month and calculate weekly retention percentages.

tasks.title: Plot retention curves
tasks.description: Use seaborn to draw line charts for each cohort on the same axes.

tasks.title: Add narrative insights
tasks.description: Identify the strongest and weakest cohorts and suggest possible reasons.

tasks.title: Publish on GitHub
tasks.description: Push the notebook and README to a public repo and add a project description.

phases.title: Getting Ready
phases.summary: Polish storytelling, advanced topics, and job‑search readiness.

milestones.title: Storytelling with Data
milestones.outcome: You can craft compelling narratives that guide decision‑makers.

tasks.title: Read storytelling guide
tasks.description: Study the free “Storytelling with Data” PDF chapters on visual hierarchy and audience focus.

tasks.title: Rewrite project conclusions
tasks.description: Take one portfolio project and rewrite its findings as a 3‑minute slide deck narrative.

tasks.title: Create a data‑story video
tasks.description: Record a short screen‑capture walkthrough of your dashboard, adding voice‑over explanations.

tasks.title: Gather peer feedback
tasks.description: Share the deck with a colleague or online community and note two improvement points.

tasks.title: Reflect on storytelling gaps
tasks.description: Write a brief note on what storytelling elements you still need to strengthen.

milestones.title: Advanced Analytics Basics
milestones.outcome: You gain exposure to predictive modeling and automation.

tasks.title: Complete intro to regression tutorial
tasks.description: Follow the free Kaggle micro‑course on linear regression using scikit‑learn.

tasks.title: Build a simple model
tasks.description: Predict sales using two features and evaluate RMSE on a hold‑out set.

tasks.title: Automate report generation
tasks.description: Write a Python script that updates your dashboard CSV and emails a PDF snapshot daily.

tasks.title: Document model assumptions
tasks.description: Add a markdown cell in your notebook explaining data limits and model risks.

tasks.title: Discuss with a mentor
tasks.description: Schedule a 30‑minute chat with a data‑science mentor on LinkedIn about next steps.

milestones.title: Job‑Search Preparation
milestones.outcome: You are ready to apply, interview, and secure a data analyst role.

tasks.title: Polish resume with metrics
tasks.description: Update your CV to include quantifiable results from each portfolio project.

tasks.title: Optimize LinkedIn profile
tasks.description: Add a headline, summary, and project links highlighting your analytical impact.

tasks.title: Mock SQL interview
tasks.description: Use LeetCode’s database problems to practice writing queries under time pressure.

tasks.title: Prepare STAR stories
tasks.description: Write three Situation‑Task‑Action‑Result narratives about data challenges you solved.

tasks.title: Apply to 5 jobs
tasks.description: Submit tailored applications to analyst openings, tracking responses in a spreadsheet.
